items.stem: Net pay is best defined as:

options.rationale: Correct: net pay is what remains after deductions.
Employer costs are not added to the employee's net pay.
Net pay is after deductions, not equal to gross.
Net pay covers all earnings less deductions.

items.explanation: Correct: net pay is what remains after deductions.

items.stem: Which two statements about statutory payroll costs are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: Some contributions are borne by the employee via deduction
options.rationale: Correct: employees fund some contributions through deductions.

options.text: Some contributions are an additional cost borne by the employer
options.rationale: Correct: employers pay their own share on top of wages.

options.text: All statutory costs always fall only on the employee
Withholding means the employee files nothing ever
options.rationale: Withholding is collection; filing obligations can still apply.

items.explanation: Correct: employees fund some contributions through deductions.

items.stem: A control that helps prevent 'ghost employee' fraud is:

options.text: Independently verifying new starters against HR records before payment
options.rationale: Correct: independent verification stops fictitious employees being paid.

options.text: Letting one person set up and approve all new employees
options.rationale: That removes segregation and enables the fraud.

options.text: Paying everyone in cash with no records

options.rationale: Skipping reconciliation lets errors and fraud slip through.

items.explanation: Correct: independent verification stops fictitious employees being paid.
